business_problem: Jeongyookgak has achieved rapid annual growth while revolutionizing the distribution culture of the livestock industry by establishing a new food paradigm. In 2022, it acquired Chorocmaeul, the first eco-friendly direct to consumer (D2C) food franchise in Korea, which currently provides food service to 2.8 million customers through 360 stores nationwide.
solution_summary: Jeongyookgak built its Databricks implementation around Databricks SQL, Delta Lake, Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines, Databricks Data + AI Platform. Jeongyookgak has achieved rapid annual growth while revolutionizing the distribution culture of the livestock industry by establishing a new food paradigm. In 2022, it acquired Chorocmaeul, the first eco-friendly direct to consumer (D2C) food franchise in Korea, which currently provides food service to 2.8 million customers through 360 stores nationwide. Databricks SQL serves governed analytics, dashboards, and ad hoc queries for business users and operational teams. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines builds transformation pipelines over shared data with Spark-based processing.

data_flow: Source data is ingested into databricks, curated in Delta Lake tables, processed with Databricks compute and orchestration services, and served through analytics, semantic search, or model endpoints for downstream users and applications. It connects with push.
business_outcome: Reported outcomes include 1,000x Data volume processed with one-third of the engineering staff; 30% Increase in the number of active customers with Databricks-powered CRM campaigns; 2x More returns on push marketing investment.
